diff:
--- trixie/debian/changelog
+++ sid/debian/changelog
@@ -1,9 +1,16 @@
-expat (2.9.0-1~deb13u1) trixie-security; urgency=high
-
-  * Non-maintainer upload by the Security Team.

- -- Salvatore Bonaccorso <carnil@debian.org>  Sun, 11 Oct 2026 15:25:11 +0200
+expat (2.10.0-1) unstable; urgency=high
+
+  * New upstream release:
+    - fixes CVE-2026-113351: denial of service with function XML_ParserReset()
+      (closes: #1151840),
+    - fixes CVE-2026-115506: denial of service from variations of billion
+      laughs attacks and parameter laughs attacks (closes: #1151841),
+    - fixes CVE-2026-117610: denial of service or more from issues with
+      initial non-final empty subparser parse calls (closes: #1152343),
+    - fixes CVE-2026-118370: signed integer overflow in function storeAtts()
+      (closes: #1152337).
+
+ -- Laszlo Boszormenyi (GCS) <gcs@debian.org>  Mon, 02 Nov 2026 20:17:03 +0100
 
 expat (2.9.0-1) unstable; urgency=high
